cards.Printed chassis (print 1): Our 3D print 1: Robot A's frame. The duck channel runs down the middle; 4 motor windows; 4.4 mm holes everywhere.
cards.Geared claw (print 2): Our 3D print 2: the claw. Grey base + 2 fingers with gear teeth (shown orange). The servo turns the right finger; the gears turn the left one the other way, so the claw opens and closes.
cards.Pocket plow (print 3): Our 3D print 3: a wide scoop on Robot B's nose. Pushes pom stacks and the pickleball.
cards.Cup hook (print 4): Our 3D print 4: long arm with a hook lip at the tip. Catches the cup rim.
cards.Black Gear Motor: Black KIPR drive motor: rectangular gearbox + round motor can, shaft on the side, 2 wires.
cards.Mecanum Wheel: Wheel with angled rollers. Rollers must form an X when seen from above.
cards.Solarbotics Wheel: Round black rubber wheel, pushes onto the motor shaft.
cards.Servo: Standard servo: black box with 2 ears (screw holes) and a spline shaft on top. 3 wires.
cards.Micro Servo: Small servo, same shape as the standard servo but half size.
cards.Round Servo Horn: Disc with a ring of small holes. Pushes onto a servo shaft.
cards.1 x 5 Servo Horn: Flat bar with 5 holes. The middle hole goes on the servo shaft.
cards.Pin w/ Friction: Black LEGO pin with a ridge in the middle. Push it through 2 beams.
cards.Servo Bracket: Bent metal plate that holds a servo by its ears.
cards.Micro Servo Mount: Small metal plate that holds the micro servo.
cards.Plate 4 x 12: Flat metal plate, 4 holes by 12 holes.
cards.Strap 1 x 10: Flat metal strip with 10 holes in a row.
cards.Channel 3 x 8: U-shaped metal channel, 3 holes wide, 8 holes long.
cards.Chassis: Big flat KIPR metal plate with folded edges: Robot B's base.
cards.Caster: Small ball caster: square plate with a free-rolling ball underneath.
cards.Wombat: KIPR Wombat controller: black box with a touch screen; ports on the sides.
cards.Wombat Battery: Battery pack with red + black wires and a plug.
cards.Lever: Switch with a long metal lever and a roller at its tip.
cards.Tophat (Reflectance): Small round blue sensor that looks down at the floor tape.
cards.ET (Rangefinder): Blue distance sensor with 2 round eyes.
cards.Light: Small light sensor with a round yellow cell on top.
cards.Black Camera: USB camera: black box with a round lens.
cards.Standoff 8-32 x 1/2\": Silver hex post, 1/2 inch long, threaded inside at both ends.
cards.Threaded Rod 8-32 x 1\": Short threaded rod: joins two standoffs end to end.
cards.Nut 8-32 Keps (black): Black nut with a toothed washer on one side (teeth face the part).
cards.Silver Servo Horn Machine Screw (M3): Small silver M3 screw (for servo horns).
cards.Short Silver Servo Horn Screw (M3): Short silver screw: holds a horn on the servo shaft.
cards.2-56 3/8\" Micro Servo Mount Screw: Tiny silver screw for the micro servo mount.
cards.2-56 1\" Caster Screw: Long thin silver screw for the caster.
cards.M3 x 0.5\" x 6\" Mecanum Wheel Screw: Screw that holds a mecanum wheel on its shaft.
cards.Zip tie 4\" (white), structural: White zip tie. Pull tight, cut the tail.
